method: Manual macro-layout comparison of every linked Act 1-5 zone page and its loaded images against all selected cached top-level graph candidates. No exact generated-map or per-template bijection is claimed.

statuses.directional_support: Directional evidence favors Y reflection; not full-layout validation
statuses.projection_issue: Macro directional evidence conflicts with the app's unreflected indoor view
statuses.family_compatible: Broad families are compatible; individual templates not identified
statuses.inconclusive: Insufficient landmarks or symmetric families to distinguish projections
statuses.nested_graph_gap: Nested graphs must be expanded before comparison
statuses.placement_gap: Room-local or disconnected composition must be resolved

pages.title: Twilight Strand
pages.note: Start SW and town NE, with the inland side NW of the shore, favor reflection. Two images do not establish coverage of three source templates.

pages.title: Coast
pages.note: Shore/inland handedness and the NE, E, N and rare southern route families support reflection. Eight examples do not prove one of nine normal topologies unused.

pages.title: Tidal Island

pages.title: Mud Flats

pages.title: Flooded Depths
